callouts.id: 已知序列模1均匀分布,那么加上log(n)对分布影响不大#1
callouts.title: 命题1，Rindler 1972
callouts.body: 假设$x_n$是模1均匀分布的序列，证明$x_n+\log(n)$也是模1均匀分布的。

classification_result.id: 已知序列模1均匀分布,那么加上log(n)对分布影响不大#1

if_problem.statement_en: Assume that $x_n$ is a sequence uniformly distributed modulo $1$. Prove that $x_n + \log(n)$ is also uniformly distributed modulo $1$.
